score_observations: Only the first music page is accessible. It is mostly piano introduction; the saxophone enters in the last system with a soft, slurred melodic phrase marked molto espressivo e cantabile.
The page shows common time and Lento espressivo quarter60. The brief solo entry includes dotted rhythm and a breath comma. It does not establish full solo range or the demands of later pages.
